label: Placebo
rationale: This is explicitly a randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled dose-escalation study. The record says participants are assigned to either NI112 or placebo, and the placebo is identified as sterile normal saline given by subcutaneous injection.

evidence.quote: Phase 1 Placebo-Controlled Study of NI112 in Adults With Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis (ALS)
Participants will be assigned by chance to receive either a single dose of NI112 or a single dose of placebo (sterile salt water).
double-blind, placebo-controlled, sequential single ascending dose-escalation study
Sterile normal saline (0.9% sodium chloride), administered as a single subcutaneous injection on Day 1.

title: A Study of Single Ascending Doses of NI112 in Adults With Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis (ALS)
